falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom was followed by a grinding recovery, not a V-shaped reversal above prior resistance; a close above 5,600 would indicate this is not that pattern and the 'bottom' call was wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 15.00 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below 15 would falsify the bottom formation thesis because August 2024's bottom featured VIX remaining elevated (18-22) for weeks post-low as consolidation occurred; immediate vol collapse signals a different regime

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield closes above 4.50% while SPX is below 5,400
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would invalidate the pattern because the August 2024 bottom coincided with yields falling (risk-off relief); simultaneous equity weakness and bond weakness (yields rising) indicates stagflationary or credit-stress dynamics, not the liquidity-driven bottom the pattern suggests

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
